messages.game.57ecbf973a10b41b: North, ever north. ...This is the gateway to the Tohoku region.
messages.game.d67f6e1cae55b12a: The sign for 授 (instruction) 業 (lessons) is running wild, and no one knows what is taught in which room.
messages.game.d9e7f70142fc047f: The 講 (lecture) sign is the room where everyone listens together. The 志 (aspiration) sign is the place where you set your heart on a goal.
messages.game.f7da31ca5a32e523: ...I read them all. The children ran off to their rooms.
messages.game.435f3efb0008075c: Children long ago learned their kanji (written characters) here. They entered at age six, every single day.
messages.game.1033924de2aa0041: 'It has been 久 (a long time) since we met. I want to see you 再 (again) one day.'
messages.game.d985e9549456d45c: The mother learned to write so she could send this letter. She practiced over and over again.
messages.game.a81842132b774cf0: ...The mother's words, written without giving up. You've made them readable again.
messages.game.65b3e1de38199e50: Shops line the broad avenue. ...Green trees stretch far into the distance.
messages.game.e329cf124c2c2a28: The shop's 価 (price) signs are running wild, and no one knows what anything costs.
messages.game.75a36dd5bc2fb17c: 得 (gain) is profit. 損 (loss) is the opposite. If you can't read the 価 (price), you can't tell which is which.
messages.game.05730f0328a714a4: ...I read them all. The customers are lining up again.
messages.game.c3b3fed1b680ce0b: A shop worker remembered that person's words: 'There aren't enough people who can read.'
messages.game.cb55fad0402052b8: Tiny islands, one after another after another. Boats weave their way between them.
messages.game.7eb92fdf1cba4f75: The old 句 (verse) signs naming the islands are running wild, and the boats' 航 (navigation) routes can't be set.
messages.game.82e3a6c4126d39f8: The same islands look different on the 往 (outgoing) trip and the return. ...It was just as the 句 (verse) said.
messages.game.af9c56be3b13c495: Easy said this: 'You've worked hard. That's plenty for now.'
messages.game.005d5cf6cd5d803f: ...And this is how I answered: 'Whether it's enough is for me to decide.'
messages.game.40ad922d3e614cb3: The branches are full of red fruit. ...If you reach out, it's within your grasp.
messages.game.d0e4f0d48e268147: The signs for the day to 採 (pick) are running wild, and the 余 (extra) fruit is about to fall.
messages.game.5a690850dce1cd81: Choosing the wrong day to 採 (pick) can strain the trees. Leave the 余 (extra) fruit for the birds.
messages.game.8de8e3fb1c3ab13b: 謝 (thanks) is the character for thank you. Everyone holding a basket wrote that character for us.
messages.game.adce30d08acef2e4: A farmer remembered that person's words: 'There aren't enough hands.'
messages.game.3ee6ee80afd55ac9: The smell of rice and the sound of weaving. ...Tok-ton, tok-ton.
messages.game.60198fff5ae8108b: The diagram of the 織 (weaving) method is running wild, and the 布 (cloth) has stopped mid-weave.
messages.game.5e0d7fd45c5ab350: Pass the threads under and over to make 布 (cloth). ...The diagram had been written in kanji (written characters).
messages.game.fa0038c5fbd40651: The loom has started clacking again. The rice is 貯 (stored) away in the storehouse.
messages.game.de417db79ae858f7: A person at the storehouse had heard that person's words: 'This won't be enough.'
messages.game.e35448d7c19c1f21: The characters returned to the sign. 'The masked god drives away calamity.'
messages.game.8a256b37c6198a89: It comes with a frightening face, but it really comes to protect the family.
messages.game.9c41b851cc342fdb: 'Not enough. Still not enough.' ...That's as far as I could hear.
messages.game.4139a9b72e8d321d: Lights, many of them, at the tips of long poles. ...They reach high into the sky.
messages.game.ea2ae9c9a0d31161: The signs describing the 序 (order) of the 技 (technique) are running wild, and no one knows the sequence.
messages.game.7322ea3df00328fe: 序 (order) means sequence. Shift the 支 (supporting) hands one at a time. ...If even one is off, it all comes crashing down.
messages.game.e0af59115742f342: ...We did it. The pole is standing straight up into the sky.
messages.game.55886992d46ba1b2: A person in town said this: 'This 技 (technique) can only be passed down in writing.'
messages.game.0d2322083e734852: Dark, heavy kettles stand in a row. ...When you touch them, they're cool.
messages.game.9f07018bc86778a3: The diagram of the 型 (mold) for pouring iron is running wild, and the 質 (quality) is being ruined.
messages.game.b361948f9be53398: Just a slight difference in the 型 (mold) changes the 質 (quality). This 術 (art) has continued for hundreds of years.
messages.game.c09460d6cbdeaac6: ...It's fixed. The iron rang out with a fine sound.
messages.game.e7b0c788a8dae5d9: An artisan remembered that person's words: 'There isn't enough time.'
messages.game.8680635051d9ad21: ...The character 導 (guide) is back! The signposts are pointing up toward the top of the mountain.
messages.game.4197c2024cd9cf92: ...Everyone has reached the top of the mountain. No one is left behind now.
messages.game.2a60a10f74286e46: The lighthouse isn't trying to scare the boats. ...It shines in order to protect them.
messages.game.2b231b369963c740: A great light moves slowly down the night road. ...There are so many people.
messages.game.ab493cd466e8d793: The character 燃 (burn) is running wild, and the torches won't light. Let's calm 意気 (spirit) and 投合 (matching) too, and start the festival.
messages.game.6e362a5c5c9303fe: 意気投合 (hitting it off) means feelings agreeing with each other. Both figures have calmed, and the order to 燃 (light) each 団 (unit/group) is set.
messages.game.ce7d4050d156e78a: The fires are lit. 興 (excitement) is when the heart wells up. ...A night just like that character.
messages.game.8d4460b325101647: ...Ah. In the light, a large 傘 (umbrella). Neither the kanji nor the people—no one has fled.
messages.game.73e1cf987063916a: 一路平安 (a safe journey all the way) is a phrase wishing travelers safety. Both figures have calmed, and the road is clear.
messages.game.b09db89cbbecd987: Waiting in line, paying the money... like an ordinary person.
messages.game.ff95e8ccc2bab6b7: That person's boat left first. Let's catch up on the next one.
messages.game.b622260910383af6: Someone in this harbor must have seen that person get off the boat. ...Let's go ask, up to the top of the hill.
messages.game.fada3b1efd9882b5: But characters have gone missing from the signs for the years the western buildings were 築 (built), and no one can tell which building is 旧 (old).
messages.game.96737cdc906ba3e4: 文明 (civilization) and 開化 (enlightenment) are running wild too. Let's calm them all down and make the 歴 (history) of this town readable.
messages.game.e16f55035be92229: The characters have returned to the signs. Looking at them in order of when each was 築 (built), you can see how the town spread out from the harbor.
messages.game.d2652e8fe3dc569a: 文明開化 (civilization and enlightenment) is when foreign culture arrives and daily life changes. This 旧 (old) western building, too, tells that 歴 (history).
messages.game.f748503db9667675: We got to ask someone at the harbor. They say the person with the large 傘 (umbrella) got off the boat and headed north.
messages.game.154eb6eb273ea654: Someone at the harbor remembered that person's words: 'One person isn't enough.'
messages.game.e8035e1988a9ad87: ...The characters 比 (compare) and 賞 (prize) are back! We can compare the statues and decide the prize.
messages.game.5177d74191d057c9: 十人十色 (ten people, ten colors). What each person likes is different for everyone. You can't decide by size alone.
messages.game.7c8673eb954b75fb: ...The kanji (written characters) are walking off in a line. Straight toward that castle.
messages.game.df520012196a3cf1: A big red-brick building. ...It's where the town's decisions are made.
messages.game.e476ecd77f24f950: Characters have gone missing from the town's 規則 (rules) signs, and no one knows which roads you may use.
messages.game.0ce83d508717f7a9: 品行 (conduct) and 方正 (uprightness) are running wild at the entrance too. Let's calm them all down and make the signs readable.
messages.game.8d9538d0f6b0bd04: 規則 (rules) are rules everyone decided together. The 判 (approval) seal is back too, so the town's signs are readable now.
messages.game.fb23d26c1d894fd9: This is a walking street. They say playing is allowed in the plaza. ...With this, we can go on with peace of mind.
messages.game.665054071d746b31: 品行方正 (upright and proper conduct) means acting correctly and responsibly. Rules, too, exist so everyone can live with peace of mind.
messages.game.7cbf0ed40da6baf5: The smell of cattle and their warm breath. ...Here, they care for the cattle every single day.
messages.game.d66ab696564246e9: Characters have gone missing from the signs for 飼 (raising) the cattle, so no one knows the amount of feed or which 牛 (cow) 舎 (barn) each returns to.
messages.game.6547cfd14cc14baa: On the way to the 牛 (cow) 舎 (barn), 牛飲 (guzzling) and 馬食 (gorging) are running wild too. Let's calm them all down and make the signs readable.
messages.game.bc2f9db902c35be3: ...We read the signs! We portioned the feed to suit each cow and got them all back to their 牛 (cow) 舎 (barns).
messages.game.e9258fbc1862da06: 牛飲馬食 (drinking like a cow and eating like a horse) means eating and drinking in huge amounts. In caring for cattle, the amount suited to each animal is what matters.
messages.game.3a3eca84a0762140: Entrusted with lives, you keep caring for them every day. That is the 責任 (responsibility) of the person who 飼 (raises) them. If you leave it in writing, it can be passed on to the next person too.
messages.game.332c4729fb183e50: Golden wheat fields stretch far into the distance. ...So this wheat becomes the 粉 (flour, powder) for bread, doesn't it.
messages.game.ce640f72ed8e2c51: The kanji have gone missing from the paper with the bread recipe, so we don't know the amounts of 粉 (flour) and water, or the order to 混 (mix) them.
messages.game.0dacfbcf3e6c3d22: On the farm road, the 「晴耕」 and 「雨読」 from 晴耕雨読 (farming on sunny days, reading on rainy days) are running wild, too. Let's calm everyone down so we can read the recipe.
messages.game.2aac7c8c1bb54376: We checked the recipe for the amounts of 粉 (flour) and water, then 混 (mixed) them in order. The bread rose! 査 means to examine or check.
messages.game.89421d8345ca6f41: 晴耕雨読 means tilling the fields on sunny days and reading books on rainy days. Written characters can also pass down clever ways of making the most of the harvest.
messages.game.81c8050c1bda89c4: The person in the fields remembered the words of that person who looked north. "On my own, it's not enough."
messages.game.8c4032348d11d722: 明鏡止水 means a calm mind, like a clear mirror or still water.
messages.game.01d7d6e678667d0d: 保つ (to keep/preserve), 護る (to protect). The signpost was 示 (showing) the rule to treasure this place.
messages.game.4516d4cde5ed2504: ...A young bird walks along behind its parent. We, too, head north. Soon, we'll meet that person.
messages.game.bba783b208fee86f: Someone from this village once traveled to a distant land to find the 「原因」 (gen'in, cause) of a disease.
messages.game.5b32a9c21ce8f56f: …This is a letter that person's mother wrote to them.
messages.game.46507281f040184e: Huh… characters are missing from it. I can't tell what it's trying to say.
messages.game.e6bafd6a1abb19e9: 「久」 (kyū, long time) and 「再」 (sai, again) turned into KanjiMon and ran off outside.
messages.game.9abeba32ff4f4c87: Let's help the KanjiMon of this village and restore the characters to the letter.
messages.game.e4a0246d574cd325: Up ahead are the two, 「七転」 and 「八起」 (fall seven times, rise eight). Those two are rampaging too.
messages.game.a6cad001b9a2a22d: Let's calm them all, then read the rest. …What did their mother want to say?
messages.game.0c3d4ed7828b1a33: …A snowy village. Tonight, the Namahage are making their rounds to the houses.
messages.game.4932445b50d85ac8: Spirits who come wearing red 「仮面」 (kamen, masks). …But why do they look so scary?
messages.game.cd5404eda67c3dcd: This signboard should explain why… but characters are missing from it.
messages.game.7f6036077d04afec: 仮 from 仮面 (mask), and 災 (disaster), have become KanjiMon and are running wild.
messages.game.eca645d5f69e8773: Beyond them are the two, 「問答」 and 「無用」. They're blocking the path to the signboard.
messages.game.6c8c627246f7871f: 「問答無用」 (mondō muyō) means deciding without listening to anyone. …Right now, there's no getting through to them.
messages.game.c37414e77796a431: Let's calm them all down and read the sign. We might learn why they look so scary.
messages.game.2f541fb70fe369b9: …A sea of 「険」 (ken, rugged) rocks. The waves are getting higher.
messages.game.b53ebffe85ebe852: A white lighthouse on the mountaintop. …It's dazzling. Almost too bright to look at.
messages.game.7a3b4989bb5bce61: A marker that 「導」 (dō, guides) you to high ground. The characters are rampaging and pointing every which way.
messages.game.7a542a0be4190043: At this rate, the people on the shore won't know which way to go.
messages.game.13cdb86127422177: Farther along the path, even the two, 「人命」 (life) and 「救助」 (rescue), are rampaging.
messages.game.4d96278a5984c28c: 「救」 (kyū) is a character that means to save. Those two truly hold the power to protect lives.
messages.game.f129aaf6b35c80c1: Let's calm them down and reconnect the path. Lead the people on the shore up the mountain!
messages.game.1cfa4841773f8331: …Beyond the 「境」 (sakai, boundary) of the sea lies Hokkaido. We cross by boat from here.
messages.game.9356c0a112266e86: Across the waterway… that big umbrella! He's at the ticket booth!
messages.game.bd98f67eb5143f94: Wait! I want to ask you about the characters!
messages.game.ffc3e1c7275c7347: …The sound of the boat drowns out our voices. Let's go around via the bridge.
messages.game.db238499390cb9ca: He's waiting patiently for the person ahead to move. …We can catch up now!
messages.game.01afca60d1b5b051: Now it's his turn. He pays the money and receives his ticket.
messages.game.a091984e3f4dc560: Let's hurry! …Ah, 「一路」 and 「平安」 are rampaging at the foot of the bridge!
messages.game.b0f7e3121561e3b3: They're words wishing travelers a safe journey, yet they're blocking the road.
messages.game.4645c788adecc12a: There are harbor characters here too! Let's calm these ones first, then move on to the two deeper in!
messages.game.bf6ccefe381d1361: …A huge castle of snow! A bear, snowmen… and even little dog statues.
messages.game.34472c0ba6a886a0: Here, the kids 「比」 (hi, compare) the snow 「像」 (zō, statues) and decide on a 「賞」 (shō, prize).
messages.game.866f5f361919f387: But 「比」 and 「賞」 are missing from the sign. The festival can't go on like this.
messages.game.1ed52c7bd0e09155: Some kids love the castle, and some love the dogs. We want to hear everyone's voice.
messages.game.1956475bea9849e0: …Deeper along the snowy road, 「十人」 and 「十色」 are rampaging too!
messages.game.31068cbe8b7c73b7: 「十人十色」 (jūnin toiro) means everyone has their own ideas and favorite things — "ten people, ten colors."
messages.game.aa06589159787910: Calm the nearer characters first, then the two deeper in. Restore the characters to the sign and make it a festival where everyone gets to choose.
messages.game.1d19a2e9d44cdd78: …So open. It's like a sea of grass. The river curves along slowly.
messages.game.03b2aadc150fd4a9: Oh. Big white birds. …Cranes. Two of them, walking along slowly.
messages.game.cb30e2d800610bd2: …They stopped and looked this way. Let's not get any closer.
messages.game.7d7c5356ba3cf5ce: …Something small is hiding at their feet. A chick. It's staying close to its parents.
messages.game.fb819eae325fb199: A sign for 「保護」 (hogo, protection). This is a place where cranes raise their chicks.
messages.game.23542f5c397e0bcc: The parent birds never leave their chick's side. …Let's just watch from the path.
messages.game.6e018c2ce9f72086: Follow this road and we'll reach the northern sea. Let's go quietly, so we don't startle the birds.
messages.game.f2d4812769fa927d: It's as if they're sleeping inside the ice.
messages.game.d68e7a8435f74bc3: …You're the one making the characters rampage. Gathering them here.
messages.game.584f50ea921ecdfb: Kanji that are no longer read go wild. Left alone, they hurt people.
messages.game.6a3bd3c4efb93110: So I brought them here. Inside the ice, they can't rampage.
messages.game.0dea24490833894f: …Until someone who can read them comes.
messages.game.7ed1d2eaee8048a4: They are my friends. I never told them to guard me. …Just like your friends.
messages.game.975cc1b8f20bd971: I noticed before anyone else, and I ran before anyone else.
messages.game.ed0f746693d0e980: I shouted it out loud. Again and again. …Everyone fled.
messages.game.237dfec8337d4115: In the towns where people ran away, more kanji went wild. The more towns I visited, the more it happened.
messages.game.d650d64e180edd85: …You carry kanji with you. Just like me.
messages.game.47b857b075e2aeae: I've been searching for the cause all this time. The reason kanji stopped being read.
messages.game.d633dafeb699f535: The more a town relied on Easy, the wilder its kanji became. …The numbers had been telling me that for a long time.
messages.game.102d45612fe20a73: …I didn't want to face it. Easy really does help people.
messages.game.56ec36379e2b38f0: …I thought so too. That's why I couldn't go and find out for sure.
messages.game.27f409da2eb082cb: I won't. I have to calm the kanji here.
messages.game.3a511c3436edb46d: I failed. …That's why you'll be faster than me.
messages.game.32debb452d1f3061: …They're back! The kanji are returning to their places in the letter.
messages.game.47e61fdbcdc767e1: 久 means a long time. 再 means again. …Their mother had wanted to see them for so long.
messages.game.58a350376cecd7df: "七転八起" (fall seven times, rise eight). It means getting back up, no matter how many times you fail.
messages.game.fda751967aa3f40e: "災" means calamity. It's a wish to keep sickness and bad things away from the home.
messages.game.475a98bcf5b5a2ca: Ah, a Namahage has come. …The people of the house are opening the door to welcome it.
messages.game.781ea6e553326e24: Everyone is gathered around the fire: 囲む. …Now that we can read the sign, we understand why.
messages.game.036ae6a96c71ed52: …At the edge of the village, that person with the big hat is calling something out.
messages.game.31cbc385175a7cf7: …The doors of the houses are already shut. That person is still outside.
messages.game.a0eadb6e2df52e66: "人命救助" means saving a person's life. …Both of them cleared the way for us.
messages.game.bbbb5e5d435a9b38: This way! Follow the guidepost, up to higher ground!
messages.game.52f81865577b0ba4: That powerful light shows ships where the shore is. …It's a guidepost for the sea.
messages.game.6abe484caffac389: A path that "導" guides, and the power to "救" rescue. …Even a light that looks frightening is the same.
messages.game.233d819ebece0987: …The way is open! "一路平安" (safe travels) also sends off those setting out on a journey.
messages.game.b150ce3bf182e7f3: Hurry, to the dock! …Wait! I still have things I want to ask!
messages.game.56e3daff2fb2e1cc: …We were too late. That person's ship is leaving the harbor.
messages.game.e5ffa2ec6a681224: The ticket was for one person. …They went "独" alone, across the sea.
messages.game.f00becaeb8715c44: Let's chase them on the next ship. The ticket says "本日限り"—valid today only. We can use it today.
messages.game.914e521d1ea99224: This time, we'll ask them. Why do they take the kanji along?
messages.game.2b204772cb619570: What the children chose was… this small statue of a dog!
messages.game.4849459d798dae9d: They say they like a dog that looks like it would play with them, more than a grand castle.
messages.game.f220c659af807afc: …Huh? Beyond the snow castle. Even further, past the forest…
messages.game.185d1b0474cdf7ec: …A castle that far away, too. From here, we'll cross town after town, forest after forest to get there.
messages.game.393165a9ee82276b: That's not white snow. It's clear, translucent blue… a castle of ice.
messages.game.7a1351203bb68cb6: It seems someone from a distant country lives in that castle.
messages.game.537feaa0525dbca2: Could all the lines of kanji we've seen have been heading there too?
messages.game.bc2322990924392d: Let's go north. This time, we'll find out why that person takes the kanji along.
